Rashi on Chullin 30a:10:1.hebrew: בשנים ושלשה מקומות - שחתך כאן, וחזר והתחיל לשחוט למטה או למעלה:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:10:1.english: In two or three places - That he cut here, and then went back and began slaughtering lower down or higher up.

Rashi on Chullin 30a:10:2.hebrew: מפורעת - מגולה ונכרת, דהיינו במקום אחד:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:10:2.english: Uncovered - Exposed and cut through, meaning in one place.

Rashi on Chullin 30a:11:1.hebrew: חץ שחוט - שחיטה דומיא דחץ, שאינו חותך בב' מקומות:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:11:1.english: An arrow, slaughter - [The] slaughter [must be] similar to an arrow, which does not cut in two places [at once].

Rashi on Chullin 30a:12:1.hebrew: ב' אוחזין בסכין - קס"ד בב' סכינין, אחד למעלה לצד הראש ואחד למטה לצד החזה:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:12:1.english: Two people hold a knife - It enters one's mind [that this refers] to two knives, one above, toward the head, and one below, toward the chest.

Rashi on Chullin 30a:13:1.hebrew: בסכין אחד - ומאי "אחד"? אחד למעלה ואחד למטה, דנקטי סכינא באלכסון:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:13:1.english: With one knife - And what is meant by "one"? One above and one below, as they hold the knife diagonally:

Rashi on Chullin 30a:14:1.english: If so - This is an expression of a challenge.

Rashi on Chullin 30a:1:1.hebrew: סתימתאה - שיש משנה וברייתא הרבה שאמר ר' אלעזר בר' שמעון, ורגילים התנאים לסדרן במשנה בלשון סתם, והאי סתמא דתזבח הוא נמי אמרה, וגמרא גמיר לה ר' יוחנן מרביה, דהא ר' אלעזר אמרה:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:1:1.english: An anonymous [teaching] - For there are many mishnayot and baraitot that R. Elazar b. R. Shimon stated, and the Tanna'im were accustomed to arrange them in the Mishna in anonymous language. And this anonymous [mishna] of "tizbach" he too stated, and R. Yochanan learned it as a tradition from his teacher, for R. Elazar stated it.

Rashi on Chullin 30a:1:2.hebrew: זבח אחד - ולרבנן ליפלוג. ועוד, לר' אלעזר גופיה ליפלוג, כגון דשחטה חד גברא בתרי סודרי, שבאמצע שחיטה בא חברו ונטל סודרו מראשו ועטפו בסודר אחר, ומדלא מפליג ש"מ תרווייהו מיטמו, דישנה לשחיטה מתחלה ועד סוף:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:1:2.english: One sacrifice - And according to the Rabbis, let him distinguish [between cases]. Furthermore, according to R. Elazar himself, let him distinguish, for example, where one person slaughtered it while wearing two head-cloths, where in the middle of the slaughter his fellow came, took his own cloth off his head, and wrapped him with a different cloth. And since [R. Elazar] does not distinguish, learn from this that both [cloths] become impure, because the slaughter is in effect from beginning to end.

Rashi on Chullin 30a:2:1.hebrew: אלא - לא מתרץ כרב יוסף, אלא הכי תריץ: דתנא בפרה פסולה איצטריך ליה לפלוגי ולאשמועינן, דאע"ג דנפסלה, מיהו קודם פסולה תורת פרה עליה, והעסוקין בה נטמאו. ובהכשרה לא חש לאורויי אי ישנה לשחיטה מתחלה ועד סוף, אי אינה אלא לבסוף:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:2:1.english: Rather - [Rava] does not answer like Rav Yosef, but rather answers as follows: The tanna needed to disagree and teach specifically about a disqualified cow, to teach that even though it became disqualified, nevertheless before its disqualification it had the status of a cow, and those engaged with it became impure. But with regard to its being valid, he did not bother to instruct whether it is present for the slaughter from beginning to end, or is present only at the end:

Rashi on Chullin 30a:3:1.hebrew: ובמועד לשמו פטור - בשוחט הפסח על החמץ קאי בפרק תמיד נשחט (פסחים דף סג.), ומרבינן התם לשאר זבחים ששחטן בפסח על החמץ שלוקה עליהן משום "לא תשחט על חמץ". וקאמר ר' שמעון שהשוחט פסח בתוך המועד, כגון שאבד בארבעה עשר והקריב אחר תחתיו ונמצא הראשון במועד, ושחטו לשמו על החמץ, פטור, דהא זבח פסול הוא דלא חזי שלא בזמנו לשמו:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:3:1.english: And during the festival, [if he slaughtered it] for its own name, he is exempt - This refers to one who slaughters the Paschal offering while there is still leavened bread [in his possession], which is discussed in the chapter "Tamid Nishchat" (Pesachim 63a). There we include other sacrifices as well, that if one slaughtered them on Passover while leavened bread [was still in his possession], he receives lashes for them because of [the prohibition] "You shall not slaughter [the blood of My sacrifice] with leavened bread." And Rabbi Shimon says that one who slaughters a Paschal offering during the festival, for example where [the first one] was lost on the fourteenth [of Nisan] and he offered another in its place, and the first was found during the festival, and he slaughtered it for its own name while leavened bread [was in his possession], is exempt, since it is a disqualified sacrifice, which is not fit when [slaughtered] not at its proper time, even for its own name.

Rashi on Chullin 30a:3:2.english: Not for its own sake - That is, he slaughtered it for the sake of a peace offering.

Rashi on Chullin 30a:3:3.hebrew: חייב - דפסח לאחר זמנו קרב שלמים, וזה שנשחט לשלמים זבח כשר הוא. ומדקתני "שלא לשמו חייב", מכלל דרישא דקתני "לשמו פטור" היינו דשחטיה סתמא, וסתמא קרי "לשמו". דאי "לשמו" דוקא קאמר, הא סתמא חייב, קשיא סיפא דלא מחייב ליה אלא בשלא לשמו בהדיא. וגרסינן: "והוינן בה, טעמא דשלא לשמו הא סתמא פטור":
Rashi on Chullin 30a:3:3.english: He is liable - For a Pesach offering after its time is sacrificed as a peace offering, and this animal, which was slaughtered as a peace offering, is a valid sacrifice. And since [the mishna] teaches "not for its own name, he is liable," it follows that the first clause, which teaches "for its own name, he is exempt," refers to a case where he slaughtered it without specifying, and an unspecified slaughter is called "for its own name." For if [the mishna] means "for its own name" precisely, then [in a case of] unspecified slaughter he would be liable, [and] the latter clause is difficult, since it holds him liable only when he slaughtered explicitly not for its own name. And we read [in the text of the Gemara]: "And we discussed it: The reason [he is liable] is that it was not for its own name, but [if it was] unspecified, he is exempt."

Rashi on Chullin 30a:4:1.english: And we raised a difficulty about it - In the unspecified case [where he slaughtered without stating any intention], why is he exempt?

Rashi on Chullin 30a:5:1.hebrew: הא סתמא שלמים הוא - דנפקא לן מ"וזבחת פסח לה' אלהיך צאן ובקר", דמותר פסח קרב שלמים, בפסחים (דף ע:) ובמנחות (דף פג:) ובזבחים בפ"ק (דף ט.):
Rashi on Chullin 30a:5:1.english: But an unspecified [offering] is a peace offering - For we derive from "And you shall sacrifice the Passover offering to the Lord your God, from the flock and the herd" that the leftover Passover offering is offered as a peace offering, [as discussed] in Pesachim (70b), in Menachot (83b), and in the first chapter of Zevachim (9a).

Rashi on Chullin 30a:5:2.hebrew: ש"מ - מדקרי ליה פסול דפסח בשאר ימות השנה, בעי למיעקר שם פסח מיניה, וכל כמה דלא עקר פסח הוא. וכי שחיט ליה שלא בזמנו, הוי פסח פסול. ומיפלג פליגי בה בפסחים (דף עג:):
Rashi on Chullin 30a:5:2.english: Learn from this - Since they call it "a disqualified Pesach offering" during the rest of the year, [it follows that] one needs to remove the name "Pesach" from it, and as long as one has not removed it, it is a Pesach. And when one slaughters it not at its proper time, it is a disqualified Pesach offering. And they [the Tannaim] do in fact disagree about this in Pesachim (page 73b).

Rashi on Chullin 30a:6:1.english: Rabbi Chiyya bar Gamda said: It was thrown - This is an answer that I give in the name of a group [of Sages], and they said: In truth, it does not require lifting, and as for that which implies that it does require lifting...

Rashi on Chullin 30a:6:2.hebrew: כגון שהיו בעלים - בפסח ראשון טמאי מתים, ופסח זה לא נדחה מחמת איבוד אלא מחמת בעלים שנדחו מחמת טומאה לפסח שני, והאי פסח חזי ליקרב באייר, הלכך בעי עקירה:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:6:2.english: For example, where the owners were - ritually impure through contact with the dead at the first Pesach. This Pesach offering was not deferred because of loss, but because of owners who were deferred to the second Pesach on account of impurity. And this Pesach offering is fit to be offered in Iyar; therefore it requires uprooting [i.e., a separate act of removal from its status as a Pesach offering].

Rashi on Chullin 30a:7:1.hebrew: אי אמרת בשלמא ישנה לשחיטה מתחלה ועד סוף, אפסיל ליה בתחלת שחיטה - דסתמיה הוי לפסח, דתחלת שחיטה נמי פסלה:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:7:1.english: If you say, granted, that [the disqualifying intent applies] to the slaughter from beginning to end, I can disqualify it at the start of the slaughter - For its unspecified [status] is that of a Paschal offering, [and so] the beginning of the slaughter also disqualifies it.

Rashi on Chullin 30a:7:2.hebrew:
אלא אי אמרת לא פסלה עד גמר שחיטה - הא גמר שחיטה לאו פסח הואי, דכיון דשחט ביה פורתא ולא איחזי לשהוייה לפסח שני, אידחי ליה מפסח. וכיון דלא חזי לפסח, הא אמרת דלשלמים קאי, וגמר שחיטה דידיה לשלמים הוא, ובפורתא קמא לא איפסל משום שחיטת פסח שלא בזמנו, דהא אינה לשחיטה אלא לבסוף:
לשם פסח קא שחיט לא גרסינן:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:7:2.english:
But if you say that it is not disqualified until the completion of the slaughter - The completion of the slaughter is not [the slaughter of] a Passover offering. For since he slaughtered a little of it, and it was not fit to be held over for the Second Passover, it was rejected from being a Passover offering. And since it is not fit to be a Passover offering, you have said that it stands as a peace offering, and the completion of its slaughter is [the slaughter of] a peace offering. And in the first small part [of the slaughter] it was not disqualified on account of slaughtering a Passover offering not at its proper time, since the slaughter is counted only at the end.
"He slaughters for the sake of a Passover offering" - we do not have this reading:

Rashi on Chullin 30a:8:1.hebrew: מדמי פסח - ראוי הוא לימכר קודם גמר שחיטה ולצאת לחולין, שאין לך מום קבוע גדול מזה, ודמיו לפסח. וכיון דחזי לדמי פסח, סתם שחיטה דידיה כולה לפסח:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:8:1.english: From the proceeds of a Passover offering - It is fit to be sold before the slaughter is completed and to go out to non-sacred status, for you have no permanent blemish greater than this, and its proceeds [are used] for a Passover offering. And since it is fit for the proceeds of a Passover offering, an unspecified slaughter of it is entirely for a Passover offering:

Rashi on Chullin 30a:9:1.hebrew: וכי תימא - אין קדשים נפדין בלא העמדה והערכה, כדכתיב (ויקרא כז) "והעמיד את הבהמה לפני הכהן והעריך הכהן אותה", וזו אין יכולה לעמוד על רגליה:
Rashi on Chullin 30a:9:1.english: And if you say - Consecrated animals cannot be redeemed without standing [before the priest] and valuation, as it is written (Leviticus 27): "And he shall stand the animal before the priest, and the priest shall value it," and this one [the animal with the torn windpipe] cannot stand on its legs.

Tosafot on Chullin 30a:10:1.hebrew: השוחט בשנים או בג' מקומות - פירש בקונטרס: חתך כאן וחזר והתחיל לחתוך למעלה או למטה. וקשה, דאם אין רוב במקום אחד, היאך שחיטתו כשרה? ואם יש רוב במקום אחד, א"כ שחיטה מפורעת היא. וי"ל דאע"ג דיש רוב במקום אחד, לא הוי שחיטה מפורעת; דבשלא נחתך הסימן, לא למעלה מבית השחיטה ולא למטה, אז הויא שחיטה מפורעת, דבית השחיטה מירווח רווח; אבל כשנחתך למעלה או למטה, לא מירווח ואינה מפורעת. וכי פריך משנים אוחזין בסכין ושוחטין, לא הוי מצי לשנויי דהתם כששחט כל אחד רוב, והרי היא מפורעת; דמ"מ כשקדם האחד ושחט רוב, וחבירו לא שחט עדיין אלא מיעוט, אינה מפורעת ונפסלה, וכיון דכבר נפסלה, תו לא הדרא ומתכשרא כשגם חבירו גמר הרוב. ובשאלתות דרב אחאי מפרש ב' או ג' מקומות, כגון שכל אותן מקומות בהיקף של סימן, כגון שחתך סביב סביב, כאן מעט וכאן מעט, בטבעת אחת בקנה, וכיוצא בו בוושט, ובין הכל יש רוב. ועוד פירש בשאלתות שאפילו חתך מיעוט הקנה למעלה לצד העור, וחזר ושחט מיעוטו למטה לצד אחר, זה שלא כנגד זה, דכשרה, כיון דבין הכל יש רוב. ורבינו חננאל פירש ב' או ג' מקומות, כגון רוב הקנה למעלה ורוב הוושט למטה, ולפירושו לא משכחת שלשה מקומות:
Tosafot on Chullin 30a:10:1.english: One who slaughters in two or three places - Rashi explained: He cut here, and then returned and began to cut above or below. But this is difficult: if there is no majority in one place, how is his slaughter valid? And if there is a majority in one place, then it is a disrupted slaughter (shechitah mefura'at)! And one can answer that even though there is a majority in one place, it is not a disrupted slaughter. For when the organ (siman) was not cut, neither above the place of slaughter nor below, then it is a disrupted slaughter, since the place of slaughter is [already] loosened; but when it was cut above or below, it is not loosened, and it is not disrupted. And when [the Gemara] objects from [the case of] two who hold a knife and slaughter, it could not have answered that there, each one slaughtered a majority, and so it is disrupted; for in any case, when one preceded and slaughtered a majority, and his fellow had not yet slaughtered more than a minority, it is not disrupted and it became invalid, and since it already became invalid, it does not return and become valid when his fellow also completes the majority. And in the Sheiltot of Rav Achai, he explains "two or three places" as, for example, where all those places are within the circumference of a single organ (siman), for example, where he cut all around, a little here and a little there, in one ring of the windpipe, and similarly in the gullet, and between all of them there is a majority. And he further explained in the Sheiltot that even if he cut a minority of the windpipe above, on the side of the skin, and then returned and slaughtered a minority of it below, on a different side, this not opposite that, it is valid, since between them all there is a majority. And Rabbeinu Chananel explained "two or three places" as, for example, a majority of the windpipe above and a majority of the gullet below; and according to his explanation, one would not find [a case of] three places:

Tosafot on Chullin 30a:12:1.hebrew: מתיב רבי אלעזר שנים אוחזין בסכין ושוחטין - לפירוש רבינו חננאל והשאלתות, לא בעי לשנויי דהכא כששחט האחד הרוב, דהא משמע שהשחיטה כשרה על ידי שניהם:
Tosafot on Chullin 30a:12:1.english: R. Elazar raised an objection: Two people may hold a knife and slaughter - According to the explanation of Rabbenu Chananel and the She'iltot, [the Gemara] does not want to answer that here [the case is] where one of them slaughtered the majority [of the windpipe or gullet], since it implies that the slaughter is valid through both of them.

Tosafot on Chullin 30a:14:1.hebrew: דלמא סמכי אהדדי ולא עבדי רובא - לפירוש הקונטרס, כל אחד לא ישחוט רוב; ולפירוש השאלתות, בין שניהם לא יעשו רוב:
Tosafot on Chullin 30a:14:1.english: Perhaps they lean on one another and do not perform the majority - According to the explanation of the Kunteres (Rashi), each one may not slaughter a majority [of the windpipe or gullet]; and according to the explanation of the She'iltot, between the two of them they may not make a majority.

Tosafot on Chullin 30a:4:1.hebrew: והוינן בה טעמא דשלא לשמו הא סתמא פטור - כך היא גירסת הקונטרס, וקשה, דאדדייק מסיפא נידוק מרישא איפכא: טעמא דלשמו, הא סתמא חייב, אלמא דלא בעינן עקירה. וברוב ספרים ישנים גרסינן: והוינן בה, לשמו אמאי פטור, פסח בשאר ימות השנה שלמים הוא, ש"מ בעי עקירה. פי' דאי סתמא לא בעי עקירה, א"כ סתם הוי שלמים וכשר כששחטו לשם פסח, מידי דהוה אשלמים ודאי ששחטן לשם פסח דכשרין:
Tosafot on Chullin 30a:4:1.english: And we discussed it: the reason is that it was not for its own sake; [but] if it was unspecified, he is exempt - This is the reading of the Kuntres (Rashi). But it is difficult: rather than inferring from the latter clause, let us infer from the first clause the opposite: the reason [he is liable] is that it was for its own sake, [but] if it was unspecified, he is liable — so evidently we do not require uprooting (akira)! And in most old books we read: "And we discussed it: [if it was slaughtered] for its own sake, why is he exempt? A Pesach offering during the rest of the days of the year is a peace offering. Conclude from this that it requires uprooting (akira)." That is, if an unspecified [slaughter] did not require uprooting, then an unspecified [animal] would be a peace offering and valid when he slaughtered it in the name of a Pesach offering, just as with peace offerings that he certainly slaughtered in the name of a Pesach offering, which are valid.

Tosafot on Chullin 30a:8:1.hebrew: מדמי פסח מי אידחי - ואם תאמר, ממה נפשך אידחי גם מדמי פסח, דמכי שחיט פורתא אינה ראויה לפדות אלא לכלבים, ואין פודין קדשים להאכילן לכלבים. ואם לאחר פדיון גומר שחיטתו, אם כן הויא לה חולין בעזרה ואסורה באכילה. וי"ל, דמיד אחר פדיון יוציאנו חוץ ויגמור שם שחיטתו:
Tosafot on Chullin 30a:8:1.english: [Is it] from the proceeds of a Pesach that it was rejected? - And if you say: Either way, it should also be rejected from [being redeemed for] the proceeds of a Pesach, for once he has slaughtered a little, it is fit to be redeemed only [to be fed] to dogs, and one may not redeem consecrated animals in order to feed them to dogs. And if he finishes its slaughter after the redemption, then it becomes non-sacred animal slaughtered in the Temple courtyard (*ḥullin ba-azarah*) and is forbidden to be eaten. And one can answer: Immediately after the redemption, he should take it outside and finish its slaughter there.

Tosafot on Chullin 30a:9:1.hebrew: והתנן שחט בה שנים או רוב שנים ועדיין היא מפרכסת הרי היא כחיה לכל דבריה - אין המשנה כן בשום מקום, אלא דדייק לה מתניתין דהעור והרוטב (לקמן חולין קיז:), דתנן: השוחט בהמה טמאה לעובד כוכבים ומפרכסת, מטמאה טומאת אוכלין, אבל לא טומאת נבלות:
Tosafot on Chullin 30a:9:1.english: But we learned in a mishnah: If one slaughtered in it two [organs] or the majority of two, and it is still convulsing, it is like a living animal for all its matters - The mishnah does not read this way anywhere, but rather [the Gemara] infers it from the mishnah of "the hide and the gravy" (below, Chullin 117b), for we learned: One who slaughters an unclean animal for a gentile, and it is convulsing, it imparts the impurity of foodstuffs, but not the impurity of carcasses (nevelot).
